sceneSources.Radio booth:
label ${Radio booth}:
    scene bg booth with dissolve
    show alex happy at left
    show morgan calm at right with fade
    show alex at center
    play music music_theme
    play sound sfx_bell
    alex "The shift is over. Where shall we go?"
    "Choose a road at sundown."
    menu:
        "Rooftop":
            jump ${Rooftop}
        "Riverside":
            jump ${Riverside}
sceneSources.Rooftop:
label ${Rooftop}:
    scene bg rooftop with fade
    show alex happy at right with dissolve
    show alex happy
    $ heard_news = True
    $ trust = 9223372036854775807
    $ route = "rooftop"
    alex "Rooftop: a shared plan."
    stop music
    hide alex with fade
    jump ${Station platform}
sceneSources.Riverside:
label ${Riverside}:
    scene bg riverside with fade
    show morgan calm at left with dissolve
    show morgan calm
    $ heard_news = False
    $ trust = -9223372036854775808
    $ route = "riverside"
    morgan "Riverside: separate ways."
    stop music
    hide morgan with fade
    jump ${Station platform}
sceneSources.Station platform:
label ${Station platform}:
    "We meet again at the station."
    return
